verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a hosted or self-hostable design platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest items are a privacy promise ('never make business out of your data') and self-hosting, which are adjacent controls, not an opt-out mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
